name: Nova Santa Rosa (Brazil)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist bearing a dark blue star and a red lower fly.
history: Nova Santa Rosa is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag was designed by the vexillologist and heraldist Arthur Luponi: white for peace and friendship, red for valour and struggle, and the blue star for the municipality.

features.role: white upper hoist and red lower fly
